s1.desc: a bathroom with round ice-block washbasins on a cream counter against a plain pale wall

spans.view: with the two of them standing behind neighbouring washbasins

beats.text: Pax brushes the tuft on his head with a red hairbrush while Polly rinses her toothbrush under the running tap at the next basin
Polly lifts her toothbrush and sets it down on the counter
Polly leans across and touches Pax's flipper while he turns his head to look at her, hairbrush raised

spans.notes: the counter hides them below the chest
extreme close-up insert: Polly's flipper pokes Pax's flipper; only flippers visible
slow continuous push in over the whole shot (basin grows every frame); Polly swoons at Pax with hearts while he holds the hairbrush
